calls.reason: OpenAI pitched GPT-4.5 as a pure scale-up, but its own system card still shows a 19% PersonQA hallucination rate, weak jailbreak resistance and 36.7% on AIME. Even with post-training added, none of the three problems was solved.

No source breaks down what AI funding was spent on. Epoch's estimate that only about 10% of OpenAI's 2024 R&D compute went to final training runs covers one company and cuts against the claim, so the evidence is thin and mixed.

In June 2025, the MindCube benchmark (co-authored by Fei-Fei Li) found near-random spatial reasoning in VLMs, and Apple's study found reasoning models collapsing on harder puzzles. A rebuttal of the Apple study weakens one piece but does not show reasoning was reliable.

OpenAI's own posts show tools and Python improving results, but 'vindicated' and 'accidentally' are interpretive. The packet also cannot rule out any public acknowledgement, and OpenAI openly disclosed its tool integration.
